vehicleLab.title: Vehicle lab
vehicleLab.description: Explore live vehicle signals through an interactive, self-made 3D vehicle.
vehicleLab.webglUnavailable: 3D is unavailable on this device. Every vehicle signal remains readable below.
vehicleLab.illustrative: Original illustrative model, not a manufacturer asset. Unknown signals never imply closed doors or normal readings.
vehicleLab.inspectHint: Select a reading or a vehicle part to inspect it.
vehicleLab.detailHonesty: Read-only telemetry. Missing or expired signals are unavailable; the vehicle geometry is illustrative, not a control.
vehicleLab.canvas: Illustrative vehicle. Drag to orbit, pinch or scroll to zoom, use arrow keys to pan, or choose a camera view.

routeFlyover.title: Route flyover
routeFlyover.description: Replay a recorded drive as a cinematic journey along its actual route.

energyFlow.title: Where did my energy go?
energyFlow.description: Trace charge and drive energy from grid to battery to wheels, as one flow.

yearInMotion.title: Year in motion
yearInMotion.description: Watch a year of recorded journeys unfold as an animated map and timeline.

batteryWhatIf.title: Battery what-if
batteryWhatIf.description: Model battery degradation and range projections from real charge and discharge history.

driveArt.title: Drive art
driveArt.description: Turn a drive into a generated piece of art from its route, speed and power.
